The probe crossed the milepost on Wednesday at 5:16AM ET, and is now 16.094 billion miles away from our planet - equal to the distance that light travels in 24 hours. It's the furthest that any human-made object has ever traveled, and Voyager 1's journey isn't over yet. On November 19th, GTA VI will be available on both the PS5 and Xbox Series X / S, and it’s quite possibly the most anticipated video game launch of all time . Part of this has to do with the success of its predecessor, as GTA V sold more than 230 million copies over the last 13 years. Some of it has to do with the sheer length of time between releases, a period that was plagued by leaks and a handful of delays that made the wait even harder for fans. But GTA VI is now a real thing you can play, and you can also keep track of all of the important post-launch information right here. That includes our own review and interviews with the development team, as well as news on just how the game ends up resonating with players.
